# CLIENT NAME

Precedence: the client's or editor's explicit words for this video > this profile > the chosen house style
(`my-editing-style` / `brand-nat-styles`) > `studio-playbook`.

## Who and what

- Who they are, their audience, and what the videos must achieve (leads, trust, sales, followers).
- Formats we make for them: platform, aspect, typical length, how often.
- House style to start from: `my-editing-style` format X, or Brand Nat codes such as `H10 C9 L4`.

## Overrides to our defaults

Only what differs from the house style. Make each rule checkable.

| Area | Rule |
|---|---|
| Captions | e.g. Montserrat ExtraBold, all caps, white with `brand.json` accent on one keyword, 2 lines max |
| Colour | e.g. warm look `LIBRARY/grades` "studio-warm"; correct green cast first |
| Motion | e.g. lower third on first appearance only; no 3D |
| Sound | e.g. no music under testimonials; subtle UI SFX only |
| Hook | e.g. open on the result or the number, never a greeting |
| Length / pacing | e.g. 25–40 s, no pause over 0.4 s |

## Never

- Things the client has rejected or that break their compliance (claims, competitor names, words to avoid).

## Files

- `brand.json`: colours, fonts, logo path on the Drive, caption and lower-third tokens. Read it before building
  motion or captions.
- `spelling.md`: names and terms. Check every transcript against it before cutting.
- `references.md`: approved reference videos on the Drive, with what to copy from each.
